summary: Multi-currency balances by asset, with events for UI and save data by id.
overview: Add, spend and query per CurrencyDefinition asset rather than hardcoding a gold int. OnBalanceChanged pairs naturally with an animated counter, and saving writes each currency's string id so a save survives assets moving.
useCases: Gold, gems and energy in one wallet.
A shop checking affordability before offering a purchase.

params.tuning: What a new player begins with. Only applied on a fresh wallet, not over loaded save data.

gotchas.title: TrySpend is the whole transaction
gotchas.body: It checks and deducts together. Checking CanAfford and then adding separately leaves a window where the balance can change underneath you.

gotchas.title: Loading needs the currency assets to exist
gotchas.body: Saves store ids. A currency asset deleted between sessions means its balance silently disappears.
